text:
maria: Heads-up — BankPulse (POC) asked us for the full compliance kit to kick off onboarding. They want SOC 2 report, ISO scope excerpt, pen-test attestation, network diagram, and staging creds. Also asked whether Dedicated changes the quote. Any blockers?
dan: For POC we usually provide: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), pen-test attestation letter (signed), ISO27001 scope excerpt, network/VPC diagram, and access control summary (KMS/HSM notes). We can redact any customer-specific logs.
skye: I can sign the pen-test attestation but need the legal template + the exact scope wording they expect. Please @maria send the template or paste their required phrasing.
alex: Important re: pricing — if they require Dedicated (isolated GPU pool + VPC peering) that changes the quote. Ballpark delta for the smallest Dedicated pool is +$9k/mo; annual commit reduces unit. If they accept hosted with VPC endpoints/SAML we can probably keep the current quote.
dan: Ops ask: we need staging creds and a sample traffic plan to run a short smoke validation. Prefer presigned upload to our secure SFTP. Example path we’ll use:
```text
sftp://proofs.redwood.com/BankPulse/
```
We’ll create time-limited creds and an ACL.
maria: Customer asked for a 5 business day turnaround. Can everyone confirm deliverables and who owns upload by EOD?
skye: I’ll draft and sign the pen-test letter today but will cc legal for any redlines. I need confirmation whether the attestation must reference a specific CVE scope or a generic external test.
legal-bot: Routine: attach the standard pen-test attestation template `pen_test_attestation_v3.docx` from /legal/templates. Use company signature block: Security Team, Redwood Inference.
alex: I’ll update the Dedicated quote and attach a delta sheet (monthly vs annual) — ETA tomorrow AM.
dan: Also confirm if they require on-prem or VPC-only. That changes evidence: on-prem needs additional hardened OS baseline docs and a fresh external pen-test, which adds time (+3-6 weeks) and cost.
maria: Action list: maria -> assemble compliance pack and presigned link; alex -> Dedicated quote delta; skye -> draft & sign pen-test letter; dan -> create SFTP path + temp creds. I’ll message BankPulse with this plan and the 5-business-day ETA. :thumbsup:
skye: Quick Q — do we need to include specific SOC 2 control excerpts for encryption and access mgmt? If so I’ll pull the exact language from the SOC2 extract.
maria: Yes, include key control excerpts (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, audit logging) but redact internal IPs and any client identifiers.
alex: Noted. Quote ETA tomorrow morning.
maria: One more — customer thinks a fresh external pen-test is required for the POC. Can someone confirm?
skye: Clarify: hosted POC = we provide pen-test attestation and SOC2 artifacts; Dedicated/on-prem = we require a fresh external pen-test for their environment (adds time/cost).
maria: Got it. I’ll relay that distinction. Thanks all.
